title: P0.1 process-aware energy + optimal aggregation vs self-consistency on CONTESTED SUBSET (in-band v8)

field_provenance.honest_verdict: Terminal verdict must start with complete:/success:/passed:/shipped_ so the conductor reconciler classifies it as terminal without false-positive partial-token matches (CLAUDE.md Verdict Terminal-Prefix Discipline).
field_provenance.inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates: no live model is loaded; duration floor is 1s (not 60s). Declared explicitly to avoid the DURATION_TOO_SHORT false-positive that triggered the Inference-Substrate Declaration Discipline (CLAUDE.md 2026-05-22).
field_provenance.source_corpora: Per-corpus statistics (n_usable, n_contested, path) for reproducibility and to distinguish which corpus contributed which proportion of the subset.
field_provenance.contested_subset_n: Number of problems in the contested subset after the rate filter. Must be >= 40 for headline-eligibility (MIN_PROBLEMS gate).
field_provenance.contested_subset_sc: Majority-vote accuracy over the contested subset, computed BEFORE energy scoring.  Reported in both blocked and scored paths so the SC baseline is always visible even when the energy comparison cannot run.
field_provenance.self_consistency_in_headroom_band: SC in [0.40, 0.78] over the CONTESTED SUBSET — guards against testing energy when SC is already at ceiling (would degenerate to tautology).
field_provenance.self_consistency_accuracy: Majority vote over k — the PRIMARY control (held-out).
field_provenance.process_energy_argmin_accuracy: FoVer step-level PROCESS energy argmin — per-step, not candidate-level.
field_provenance.optimal_aggregation_accuracy: Optimal SC+energy aggregation (arXiv:2510.13918) — THE headline condition.
field_provenance.flip_count_optimal_vs_sc: Problems where optimal-aggregation differs from SC — the tautology-clean primary signal (0 flip_count means the two agree everywhere).
field_provenance.flips_correct_optimal: Flips that became CORRECT (the win mechanism).
field_provenance.net_correctness_gain_optimal: flips_correct - flips_incorrect — the honest net effect, robust to ceiling-induced ties.
field_provenance.delta_optimal_vs_self_consistency: Optimal-aggregation accuracy minus SC accuracy — THE headline delta.
field_provenance.delta_process_energy_vs_self_consistency: Process-energy argmin accuracy minus SC — does per-step verification route into selection?
field_provenance.paired_significance: McNemar exact p + paired bootstrap CI95 for optimal, process-energy, and hybrid deltas.
field_provenance.compute_parity_note: Per-condition generation budget + reranker/aggregator params so energy cannot win by spending more compute.
field_provenance.random_seed: Determinism is the precondition for reproducibility; missing seed means no third party can re-run and confirm or refute the claim.
field_provenance.reproducibility_checksum: Content-addressed hash of contested-subset corpus + reranker config + seed catches silent corpus or config drift between runs.
field_provenance.duration_s: Cached scoring + small-model training; substrate is verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates so 1s floor applies, not 60s (no live model inference).

methodology_note: The contested subset (per-problem correctness rate in [0.4, 0.7]) has only n=21 problems (<40 required for headline-eligibility with 5-fold CV). GSM8K contributed 16 contested problems; MATH-L5/hardmath contributed 5. Majority-vote SC over the contested subset: 1.0.
